Package CommonComponents

Class CommonComponentsAbstract

java.lang.Object
CommonComponents.CommonComponentsAbstract
public abstract class CommonComponentsAbstract extends Object
Abstract class that defines methods for creating reusable UI components such as buttons, labels, and dialogs.
